convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <throwaway.pen> with FILE-REDIRECTED stdin (GC-001 finding 8); one execute({ input: 'Export(["<frameId>"], "png", "<dir>")' }) line per frame, then exit(). Default scale 2. The .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import (../../../design-system/in-progress/hemlock-library.lib.pen) and font URI (../../fonts/Heebo-VariableFont_wght.ttf) resolve. Re-export verified byte-deterministic across consecutive runs (all 10 sha256 identical).
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1 (harness convention, GC-001 precedent), per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; the contract's pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 harness per-pixel setting, not this loop's budget); targets = NORMALIZED prototype, contract root per state (section.gg), Chromium 151 (playwright), viewport 900x600, deviceScaleFactor 2, fonts.ready + double-rAF + self-consistency gate (two captures byte-identical); Heebo served to the browser from the same TTF the .pen references (pencil/designs/fonts/Heebo-VariableFont_wght.ttf via fontconfig, Google Fonts links removed at normalization).
convergence.iterationNotes: Iteration 1 (analytic geometry from the prototype's own arc/conic math + measured text baselines, pen text rule calibrated as CSS-like content-area centering with canvas fontBoundingBox metrics): 9/10 states 0.064-0.293%, error-invalid-config 1.042%. Iteration 2 (quarter-device-pixel phase probes): error text renders 0.25 css px high at 14px (integer-quantized canvas metrics); gauge-frame texts already optimal (nudges measured worse). Iteration 3 (14px/400 baseline correction +0.25 applied): error frame 0.674%, all others unchanged. Residual is cross-rasterizer text antialiasing (pen glyphs marginally thinner than Chromium's) plus arc-edge AA; the fade band's conic gradient is expressed as 1.5-degree stroked-arc steps with node opacity over the band token - step deltas and butt-joint seams are sub-threshold by construction and measurement.
convergence.geometryProbesDetail: Source-level: every frame carries the rendered prototype's path data verbatim - track d (default: M256.08 230.00 A120 120 0 1 1 463.92 230.00), cap circle centers (default tip 479.97,167.49; V2 both caps opaque unclipped; V3 start cap 0.393 clipped half-disc), graded-segments 52 segment d strings 1:1 (V5, first M256.08 230.00, last M479.44 158.38), custom-scale sweep 194.182deg (V6, tip 475.46,137.29), slider width fraction (2r+sw)/720 = 0.369444 of the section (design-rules 16), band conic stops re-expressed from the rendered conic strings (V1-V3). Pixel-space: per-state ink bounding box of export vs target within 2 css px on every edge (measured deltas 0 to -1 device px).

Near-black primary text on the control; the header/primary text role owns it. #171717 has no Hemlock step.
Secondary helper text at 11px; sem-text-subtle (#8A8680) fails the 4.5:1 small-text floor the a11y contract requires, sem-text-meta (6.4:1) passes. Contrast-driven role pick.
The slider-track role token exists (T3); role wins over the 3-unit hue delta (#D5D3D0).

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: fade/ramp band translucency + graded-segments alphas + translucent caps
tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: runtime rgba(color, alpha) conic stops and stroke alphas
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Every dim tone is node opacity over the token fill, never an alpha-baked color - a base-token swap re-themes the whole ramp; no frame carries a raw value. Conic gradients are expressed as 1.5-degree stroked-arc steps (measured sub-threshold vs the rendered conic); translucent clipped caps are exact half-disc paths.

tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: hand-rolled arc gauge + native range slider
tokenJudgmentCalls.boundToken: (none - frames carry the prototype's exact path data with token paint)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: hemlock-library has GaugeChart and Slider components, but they are different designs that cannot reproduce the executable spec's geometry (240-degree fixed-canvas arc, fade-back-from-reading band, cap discipline, arc-derived slider width). Under the two-oracle split the .pen is the pixel oracle OF THIS prototype; composing the library components would fail every pixel compare. Divergence from Hemlock's existing GaugeChart/Slider is designer-visible, not silently resolved here.

The library's shadow color tokens are named prim-shadow-*-color (naming drift vs the design-system doc's unprefixed shadow-{size}-color - reported); binding a prim-* is forbidden, so a local themed shadow color pair was created and recorded as a gap.
